source_rules.rule_summary: OpenRAM emits a full SRAM object and then saves GDS/LEF/SPICE from that assembled physical hierarchy.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: Complete GDS requires one physical hierarchy that owns both module placement and exported geometry.

source_rules.rule_summary: Physical layout is instantiated from a config object and then netlist/layout are created from the same parameter set.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: OpenYield must keep supported-config physical geometry tied to the same config used by routing and validation.

source_rules.rule_summary: Reference GDS is emitted only after layout creation and alongside LVS-oriented SPICE/LEF artifacts.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: C6 needs geometry-backed completion evidence, not a map-only handoff.

source_rules.rule_summary: Bitline naming is column-major and tied directly to bitcell column ownership.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: Complete routing must preserve physical column ownership from array pins through column periphery.

source_rules.rule_summary: Wordline naming is row-major and tied directly to bitcell row ownership.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: WL geometry must map to per-row pitch and not to abstract row-wide stripes only.

source_rules.rule_summary: Array BL/BR pins are exported as full-height geometry aligned to real bitcell pin shapes.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: This is the geometry-backed baseline missing from OpenYield contract-only BL/BR routes.

source_rules.rule_summary: Array WL pins are exported as full-width geometry aligned to row pitch and cell access height.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: OpenYield needs geometry-backed WL endpoints instead of bbox-only stripes.

source_rules.rule_summary: Array supply pins are propagated from real child instances rather than synthesized from abstract rails.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: OpenYield power closure must connect to true child rail geometry.

source_rules.rule_summary: Array height/width derive directly from bitcell row and column pitch, with mirroring respecting bitcell orientation rules.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: C3 must rebuild floorplan around real bitcell pitch rather than coarse region boxes.

source_rules.line_reference_or_pattern: L18:Assumes bit-lines and word lines are connected by abutment.
source_rules.rule_summary: The main array is the primary SRAM body and BL/WL continuity is achieved by cell abutment, not post-hoc overlay stripes.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: OpenYield needs array-owned access geometry to anchor real routing.

source_rules.rule_summary: Replica columns live on the left/right edges of the main array and dummy rows live on the top/bottom for RBL loading.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: Replica and dummy structures are not arbitrary filler; they are part of timing and edge geometry organization.

source_rules.rule_summary: Dummy rows are explicitly instantiated to carry replica wordlines through the array edge.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: C3 needs explicit boundary placement semantics for dummy/replica ownership.

source_rules.rule_summary: Regular and replica WL/BL pins are exported from actual child pins with width/height expanded to the array span.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: This is a direct precedent for geometry-backed boundary export instead of label-only pins.

source_rules.rule_summary: Supply export stays attached to child rail shapes even in replica/dummy-augmented arrays.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: C5 needs rail-to-strap stitching to start from real module rails.

source_rules.line_reference_or_pattern: L274:""" Add dummy cells or end caps around the array """
source_rules.rule_summary: Boundary caps are explicitly added around replica arrays to define legal outer edge geometry.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: C3 must replace visual placeholders with real boundary-cap organization.

source_rules.rule_summary: Wordline driver array is placed adjacent to the array with technology-scaled spacing derived from routing pitch.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: C3 needs row-periphery spacing rules tied to access/routing layers.

source_rules.rule_summary: OpenRAM separates local wordline buffering from global wordline export layers and uses explicit via stacks between them.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: OpenYield WL closure needs real layer/direction/access ownership instead of one abstract stripe layer.

source_rules.rule_summary: Global WL pins are created only after explicit local-to-global via stacks and short jogs from the driver input side.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: C4 must create access-aware WL geometry rather than bbox-only row bars.

source_rules.line_reference_or_pattern: L87:# Always add the left RBLs to the first subarray
source_rules.rule_summary: When arrays are segmented, left/right replica ownership stays on the edge local arrays only.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: C3 must keep replica timing structures at macro edges, not floating in generic control regions.

source_rules.rule_summary: Global wordlines are stitched across local arrays on a dedicated layer and exported as single continuous pins.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: Multi-slice WL geometry in OpenYield must become continuous physical nets, not separate report entries.

source_rules.rule_summary: Bank floorplan is anchored to the main array edges, with row/column/control placement computed relative to those edges.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: OpenYield C3 must floorplan from real array boundaries rather than independent region boxes.

source_rules.rule_summary: Row-address path is placed to the left of the main array while column/data path is placed below for port0.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: This defines SRAM-like relative organization for row and column periphery.

source_rules.rule_summary: For the second port, data path can move above the array while row path moves to the right, preserving array-centric organization.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: The core principle is that array remains the center and periphery attaches to edges by function.

source_rules.rule_summary: Bitline path is routed as a structured chain from precharge/column mux/sense/write logic into the bitcell array.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: OpenYield must replace one-step contract mapping with staged column-path connectivity.

source_rules.rule_summary: Replica bitline is exported to the bank boundary through explicit routed geometry and side pin placement.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: Replica control/timing signals in OpenYield need geometry-backed routing and export, not report-only ownership.

source_rules.rule_summary: Wordline driver is placed directly adjacent to the row decoder and then drives row-aligned outputs into the array edge.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: Decoder and WL-driver cannot be treated as unrelated abstract blocks in C3/C4.

source_rules.rule_summary: Decoder outputs connect to wordline-driver inputs using explicit jog routing and via stacks between real pins.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: OpenYield control/row path needs actual intermediate connectivity, not a single bbox for the whole fanout.

source_rules.rule_summary: Row-path VDD/GND are propagated from decoder and wordline-driver geometry, with extra RBL rail stitching only where needed.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: OpenYield must repair power continuity at module-rail granularity.

source_rules.rule_summary: Column path is an ordered physical chain; BL/BR do not jump directly from top-level net name to every consumer.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: This directly addresses OpenYield’s contract-only BL/BR overlay.

source_rules.rule_summary: Precharge, mux, sense amp, and write-driver arrays use common bit offsets derived from bitcell pitch and words-per-row ownership.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: C3 must align column modules to array column pitch and mux ratio.

source_rules.rule_summary: Precharge cells inherit bitcell mirror parity and column offset so BL/BR access stays aligned to the array.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: Column-path modules must respect bitcell parity, not just nominal x pitch.

source_rules.rule_summary: Precharge array exports a continuous horizontal VDD rail rather than an approximate top-level strap.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: This is the kind of geometry-backed rail OpenYield needs before top-level stitching.

source_rules.rule_summary: Sense amps are placed on word outputs, not every raw column, and words-per-row determines ownership grouping.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: C3/C4 must account for mux ratio when aligning read path modules.

source_rules.rule_summary: Sense-enable is distributed as explicit rail geometry with vias into each amplifier.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: OpenYield control distribution must become per-consumer geometry, not one contract rectangle.

source_rules.rule_summary: Write drivers are placed per word output with words-per-row grouping and spare columns handled separately.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: OpenYield write path must use word-owned geometry rather than every-column placeholder taps.

source_rules.rule_summary: Write-enable geometry is exported as a real rail segment, optionally partitioned by write-mask/spare ownership.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: OpenYield write enable cannot remain a contract fanout box.

source_rules.rule_summary: Column mux array reserves routing height proportional to words-per-row for select rails and output joins.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: OpenYield C3/C4 must allocate real routing channels instead of overlay rectangles.

source_rules.rule_summary: Mux outputs are formed by actual merged BL/BR output rails and via stacks across the grouped columns.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: OpenYield needs true mux-output ownership instead of per-consumer duplicated BL/BR rectangles.

source_rules.rule_summary: Column-select controls are distributed on dedicated horizontal rails under the mux array.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: OpenYield control routing must use organized channel rails, not one large area fill.

source_rules.rule_summary: Top-level pins are propagated by copying actual child pin shapes, preserving layer, width, and height.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: OpenYield pin export must stay geometry-backed all the way up the hierarchy.

source_rules.line_reference_or_pattern: L1058:Creates a path like pin with center-line convention
source_rules.rule_summary: A real exported pin can be a routed segment with explicit layer and bbox, not just a text label.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: This defines the minimum geometry-backed pin requirement for C2/C4/C5/C6.

source_rules.line_reference_or_pattern: L1122:Remove the old pin and replace with a new one
source_rules.rule_summary: Escape/perimeter pin relocation keeps the old geometry as wiring and replaces only the exported pin object.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: OpenYield top-pin cleanup must distinguish internal route geometry from final external pin placement.

source_rules.rule_summary: Label-only correspondence points are explicitly distinguished from actual layout pins.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: OpenYield must not treat label-only pins as sufficient evidence for complete GDS.

source_rules.rule_summary: GDS export occurs from the assembled layout hierarchy after geometry and pin maps are finalized.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: OpenYield complete-GDS claim must come only after geometry hierarchy is physically assembled.

source_rules.rule_summary: Physical macros include an explicit boundary shape tied to the final extents of real geometry.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: OpenYield macro bbox should follow actual assembled geometry, not placeholder extents.

source_rules.rule_summary: Power export can be copied from instance pin geometry before any higher-level stitching is added.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: This is the baseline for geometry-backed VDD/GND pin ownership in C2/C5.

source_rules.rule_summary: Top IO pins are derived from real instance pins and optionally escape-routed upward through specified layer stacks.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: OpenYield top IO must be backed by internal geometry and routed escape, not map-only entries.

source_rules.line_reference_or_pattern: L876:# The delay line is aligned with the bitcell array while the control logic is aligned with the port_data
source_rules.rule_summary: Control logic and delay chain placement are explicitly aligned against bank array geometry rather than free-placed.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: OpenYield control region must be organized relative to array edges and replica timing structures.

source_rules.line_reference_or_pattern: L1220:# This is something like a "spine" clock distribution. The two spines
source_rules.rule_summary: Clock distribution is implemented as explicit spine routing from control logic to DFF clusters.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: OpenYield clk/gated_clk should become explicit routed spines, not contract boxes.

source_rules.rule_summary: Non-clock control signals are routed from control logic to bank on explicit vertical buses, while replica-bitline feedback uses a dedicated m3/m4 route.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: OpenYield control paths need net-specific geometry and bus ownership.

source_rules.rule_summary: Address flops connect to bank row-address inputs with explicit intermediate metal and via stacks.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: Address routing in OpenYield must be geometry-backed up to decoder inputs.

source_rules.rule_summary: Top-level addr/din/dout/control/spare pins are exported from specific child instances, not synthesized in isolation.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: This is the physical precedent for OpenYield top-pin export in C4/C6.

source_rules.rule_summary: Perimeter pin escape routing is a dedicated post-placement routing step, not a byproduct of block placement.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: OpenYield top-level pin placement and escape must be explicit in C4/C6.

source_rules.rule_summary: Top-level supply routing is a distinct stage after signal geometry and top pins have been materialized.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: OpenYield should do C5 after C4 geometry exists so strap stitching lands on real shapes.

source_rules.rule_summary: Supply routing can add side pins or rings and then route true pin sets through a graph-based path search.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: OpenYield top-level power pins and straps should be driven by actual rail targets.

source_rules.rule_summary: Signal escape routing replaces original IO pins with perimeter-exported geometry only after successful routed escape.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: Top pin geometry in OpenYield must reflect routed escape endpoints.

source_rules.rule_summary: Structured channel routing is aware of pin conflicts, preferred directions, and track pitch rather than drawing a single placeholder rectangle.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: OpenYield signal channels need geometry-aware routing ownership in C4.

source_rules.rule_summary: Requested decoder.py file is not present in this OpenRAM checkout; decoder behavior is likely provided by other modules such as hierarchical_decoder.
source_rules.why_it_matters_for_complete_gds: The audit must explicitly mark missing source references instead of inferring behavior from absent files.

visual_geometric_conclusions: Reference macro `sram_8x64_wpr4_fd45` is array-centric: dense `cell_1rw` instances occupy bbox {'x0': 11.905, 'y0': 20.0475, 'x1': 34.655, 'y1': 43.4525, 'width': 22.75, 'height': 23.405}.
Row periphery sits `left` relative to the dense array region.
Column periphery sits `below` relative to the dense array region.
The macro shows repeated bitcell references plus narrow precharge/column/read/write bands instead of one overlay rectangle.
Top-level pin labels exist on dedicated label layers and accompany real geometry, not label-only inventory rows.

array_rules.source_evidence: OpenRAM bitcell_array/replica_bitcell_array source; reference GDS dense bitcell region
array_rules.rule_description: Bitcell array must be the dominant physical core of the macro and own row/column pitch, BL/BR access, and WL access.
array_rules.required_geometry: Real bitcell-array boundary plus per-column BL/BR shapes and per-row WL shapes.
array_rules.required_metadata: row_pitch, column_pitch, bitcell orientation parity, array bbox.

array_rules.rule_description: Row pitch and column pitch must derive from placed bitcell geometry, not top-level heuristic spacing.
array_rules.required_geometry: Measured bitcell width/height and instance placement lattice.

array_rules.rule_description: BL/BR access must be geometry-backed full-height array pins tied to real child pin layers.
array_rules.required_geometry: Vertical BL/BR pin rectangles aligned to bitcell access points.
array_rules.required_metadata: per-column net naming and source-target access ownership.

array_rules.rule_description: Each WL must have row-specific geometry-backed access aligned to row pitch.
array_rules.required_geometry: Per-row WL pin rectangles and driver landing shapes.
array_rules.required_metadata: row index to wl net map and row-order parity.

array_rules.rule_description: Dummy, replica, and cap structures must sit on array boundaries with defined timing/edge roles.
array_rules.required_geometry: Replica columns left/right, dummy rows top/bottom, optional cap cells around perimeter.
array_rules.required_metadata: which edges host replica or dummy structures and why.

array_rules.rule_description: VDD/GND array access must be copied from real child rails before any top-level strap stitching.
array_rules.required_geometry: Per-instance supply pins or continuous rail shapes at the array edge.

row_path_rules.rule_description: Row decoder sits on the row-periphery side of the array and aligns to the main array vertical span.
row_path_rules.required_geometry: Decoder bbox, array edge alignment, decoder output access points.
row_path_rules.required_metadata: row decoder side, y-alignment anchor, decoder gap.

row_path_rules.rule_description: Wordline drivers sit adjacent to the array with pitch-aware spacing and alternating row orientation.
row_path_rules.required_geometry: Driver array bbox, per-row output pins, spacing channel to array.

row_path_rules.rule_description: Decoder outputs connect to WL-driver inputs through explicit jog routes and via stacks.
row_path_rules.required_geometry: Pin-to-pin route segments between decode outputs and driver inputs.
row_path_rules.required_metadata: route layer, jog direction, per-row net mapping.

row_path_rules.rule_description: Driver outputs land on array WL pins through local/global WL layer transitions, not through one abstract row stripe.
row_path_rules.required_geometry: Driver output access, WL vias, row-specific array landing geometry.

row_path_rules.rule_description: Each WL route and driver output must honor the underlying array row pitch.
row_path_rules.required_geometry: Uniform row-step geometry from array to row path.

row_path_rules.rule_description: Row decoder and wordline-driver power rails must align with row-periphery geometry and remain stitchable to top rails.
row_path_rules.required_geometry: Continuous VDD/GND pins or rails over row path modules.
row_path_rules.required_metadata: power rail layer and connection side.

column_path_rules.rule_description: Precharge cells align to raw bitline pitch at the array column edge, including optional replica-bitline extra column.
column_path_rules.required_geometry: Per-column precharge cell placement and BL/BR pin shapes.
column_path_rules.required_metadata: column offsets, column mirror parity, has_rbl side.

column_path_rules.rule_description: Column mux sits between raw BL/BR and word-owned read/write stages, with reserved select/output routing height.
column_path_rules.required_geometry: Mux bbox, select rail channels, output join rails.

column_path_rules.rule_description: Sense amps align to word outputs, not every raw column, so words-per-row controls their x ownership.
column_path_rules.required_geometry: Word-level sense amp positions and output pin geometry.

column_path_rules.rule_description: Write drivers align to word outputs and handle spare columns separately from regular word lanes.
column_path_rules.required_geometry: Per-word write-driver geometry and enable rails.

column_path_rules.rule_description: BL/BR must connect through a physical chain: array <-> precharge <-> mux/sense/write, depending on mode and words-per-row.
column_path_rules.required_geometry: Distinct pin-to-pin routes for each consumer stage.
column_path_rules.required_metadata: mode-aware chain ownership and net aliases.

column_path_rules.rule_description: Each column path stage exports local VDD/GND rails that must be stitched to top-level power with real taps.
column_path_rules.required_geometry: Stage-local rail shapes and tap landing points.
column_path_rules.required_metadata: supply layer, edge orientation, top strap targets.

control_io_rules.rule_description: Control logic is placed relative to the bank array and row/data periphery so that control spines can reach both sides cleanly.
control_io_rules.required_geometry: Control logic bbox and anchor relative to array center.

control_io_rules.rule_description: Delay/replica timing structures stay physically aligned to array-side replica geometry and feed control logic through explicit RBL routing.
control_io_rules.required_geometry: Replica BL geometry and delay-chain placement window.
control_io_rules.required_metadata: rbl source/target mapping and edge ownership.

control_io_rules.rule_description: precharge_en/sense_en/write_en/wordline_en must be distributed on explicit buses or rails to actual sink pins.
control_io_rules.required_geometry: Control spine segments, vias, and sink landing shapes.
control_io_rules.required_metadata: sink list by net and route layer ownership.

control_io_rules.rule_description: clk and buffered clock are routed as spines with defined branch points into control and DFF clusters.
control_io_rules.required_geometry: Clock trunk, branches, and via stacks.
control_io_rules.required_metadata: clock fanout map and route stack.

control_io_rules.rule_description: addr, din, and dout should originate from the corresponding flop/bank child pins and then escape to the perimeter through explicit routing.
control_io_rules.required_geometry: Instance-backed IO pins and escape routes.
control_io_rules.required_metadata: which instance owns each external IO bit.

control_io_rules.rule_description: Top-level pins belong on the perimeter after escape routing is complete and should correspond to routed internal geometry.
control_io_rules.required_geometry: Perimeter pin shapes and matching internal routes.
control_io_rules.required_metadata: top pin side, layer, net name, source instance.

power_rules.source_evidence: bitcell_base_array.route_supplies; reference GDS bitcell/dummy rail propagation
power_rules.rule_description: Array-internal VDD/GND should propagate from the bitcell and dummy/replica children, preserving their orientation and edge reach.
power_rules.required_geometry: Array-local supply pins or continuous rails.
power_rules.required_metadata: rail layer, side/orientation, cell parity effects.

power_rules.rule_description: Row decoder and wordline drivers need explicit row-periphery rails aligned for later top-level stitch.
power_rules.required_geometry: Vertical/horizontal row-periphery rails with true pins.

power_rules.rule_description: Precharge, mux, sense, and write stages require stage-local rails before top-level straps are added.
power_rules.required_geometry: Per-stage VDD/GND rails and tap points.

power_rules.rule_description: Control region needs its own stitchable rails or ring targets before top-level strap export.
power_rules.required_geometry: Control VDD/GND rails and side/ring targets.
power_rules.required_metadata: power pin type and stitch policy.

power_rules.rule_description: Top-level VDD/GND straps or rings should be created after sink rails are known and must connect through explicit taps/vias.
power_rules.required_geometry: Top straps, corner vias, module-rail taps.
power_rules.required_metadata: strap layer stack, side or ring selection.

power_rules.rule_description: Top-level VDD/GND pins must coincide with real strap/ring geometry and not be isolated placeholders.
power_rules.required_geometry: Exported top VDD/GND pin rectangles on final strap/ring layers.

pin_label_layer_rules.rule_description: A complete-GDS pin must have geometry bbox, layer, and stable net name. A label alone is insufficient.
pin_label_layer_rules.required_geometry: Pin rectangle or routed pin segment on a real layer.
pin_label_layer_rules.required_metadata: net name, bbox, layer, owning instance/module.

pin_label_layer_rules.rule_description: Synthesized pins are only acceptable when they are copied or routed from real child geometry, not invented without a geometry source.
pin_label_layer_rules.required_geometry: Child-backed geometry and optional escape-routed replacement pin.
pin_label_layer_rules.required_metadata: source instance pin reference and replacement history.

pin_label_layer_rules.rule_description: Label-only correspondence points can help debug LVS but cannot serve as complete-GDS connectivity evidence.
pin_label_layer_rules.required_metadata: must be marked as label-only or correspondence-only.

pin_label_layer_rules.rule_description: Pin bbox, layer, label text, and net name must remain consistent when a pin is moved or replaced.
pin_label_layer_rules.required_geometry: Final pin shape plus any retained internal route geometry.

pin_label_layer_rules.rule_description: net_to_shape_map must point to real GDS shapes that survive into the final top cell, not to report-only bbox rows.
pin_label_layer_rules.required_geometry: GDS-resident shapes with stable bbox and layer.
pin_label_layer_rules.required_metadata: net_to_shape entry id, shape bbox, shape layer, source evidence path.

complete_gds_requirements.minimum_requirement: Every WL/BL/BR/control/VDD/GND/top-IO sink or source needed by current supported config must have geometry-backed access or a geometry-backed synthesized replacement pin.
complete_gds_requirements.evidence_needed: Pin inventories updated to GEOMETRY_BACKED_PIN with bbox/layer/net ownership.
complete_gds_requirements.still_not_signoff_boundary: This does not imply DRC/LVS closure.

complete_gds_requirements.minimum_requirement: Array must be the macro core; row, column, control, dummy, replica, and boundary structures must be placed relative to actual array pitch and edge access windows.
complete_gds_requirements.evidence_needed: Updated floorplan report and region bboxes derived from actual geometry.
complete_gds_requirements.still_not_signoff_boundary: This does not imply congestion-free final routing.

complete_gds_requirements.minimum_requirement: WL/BL/BR/control/clk/addr/din/dout/top-IO routes must exist as real GDS geometry between source and target access points.
complete_gds_requirements.evidence_needed: Real geometry inventory with pin-to-pin routes and no contract-only dependencies for required nets.
complete_gds_requirements.still_not_signoff_boundary: This does not imply timing closure or global route optimality.

complete_gds_requirements.minimum_requirement: VDD/GND must connect module rails to top-level straps/pins through real taps and vias; no contract-only power stitches may remain.
complete_gds_requirements.evidence_needed: Power continuity inventory with geometry-backed rails, taps, and top power pins.
complete_gds_requirements.still_not_signoff_boundary: This does not imply EM/IR signoff.

complete_gds_requirements.minimum_requirement: Net-to-shape evidence must refer to actual GDS shapes, and the repaired top GDS must parse, map, and preserve hierarchy consistently for current supported config.
complete_gds_requirements.evidence_needed: Final geometry-backed audits and parsed GDS comparison.
complete_gds_requirements.still_not_signoff_boundary: This does not imply full LVS-clean or DRC-clean status unless separately proven.

complete_gds_requirements.minimum_requirement: The minimum complete-GDS bar is geometry-backed connectivity for the current supported config across signal, power, and top pins.
complete_gds_requirements.evidence_needed: Contract/approximate counts reduced to zero for required complete-GDS claim scope.
complete_gds_requirements.still_not_signoff_boundary: Complete GDS is not equivalent to timing signoff, DRC signoff, or LVS signoff.
